page_title: LAZ 2-1 EMP | Lazio v Empoli 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+2' Ooh that was close! Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) for Mattia Zaccagni.
86' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Boulaye Dia will be replaced by Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio).
86' Nuno Tavares comes off the pitch to be replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
84' 2 - 1 Taty Castellanos plays a neat ball into the path of Pedro (Lazio), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 2:1.
83' The game has come to an end for Ola Solbakken. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli).
83' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) replacing Sebastiano Esposito.
82' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
79' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
78' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
77' Lazio enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
74' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' A substitution has been made. Gustav Isaksen goes off and Pedro (Lazio) comes on.
72' The ball is out of play. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Empoli take a short corner kick.
69' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
68' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
65' Substitution. Liam Henderson (Empoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jacopo Fazzini walks off.
65' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) replaces Faustino Anjorin.
64' Lazio are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
62' Half-chance! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) plays a pass into the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach reacts well to snuff out the attack.
59' Neat passing move from Empoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
53' Substitution. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) on for Giuseppe Pezzella.
53' The referee gives a yellow card to Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
51' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots low to the middle of the goal, but only into the gloves of a well-prepared Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach.
50' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
49' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle after Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Lazio!
47' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.
47' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' The referee can't ignore those comments and Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) sees a yellow card for bad language.

45+4' 1 - 1 Nuno Tavares showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 1:1.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
41' Adam Marusic (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
38' Problems for Marco Baroni as Manuel Lazzari is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Adam Marusic (Lazio) replaces him.
36' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
35' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
33' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
31' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) receives a yellow card!
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
28' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
26' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
24' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

24' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
22' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
20' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
17' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

16' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) accepted an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashed a decent strike towards the top right corner of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, was alert and thwarted the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Lazio will have a corner.
16' A cross by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
16' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
15' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach to dive and make a save.
14' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is penalised for holding. Giovanni Ayroldi signals a set piece. Lazio get a free kick.
13' The referee blows his whistle after Ola Solbakken (Empoli) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
12' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

9' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Giuseppe Pezzella and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Ivan Provedel was helpless.
8' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
7' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
6' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

2' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) releases Boulaye Dia, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi is the one to supervise the game today.
